extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians and researchers considering submission to Nagoya Mathematical Journal; readers of the journal; prospective authors
extracted.subtask_description: Information and high-level expectations for authors and readers of research articles submitted to the Nagoya Mathematical Journal, a quarterly journal publishing pure mathematics research of broad interest. Covers scope, publication format, and limited rights/availability notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original research papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Seeks to publish original research papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal publishes original research papers (founded 1950) — submissions should present original mathematical results rather than expository summaries or previously published work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highest quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Seeks to publish papers of the highest quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Papers are expected to meet a high standard of mathematical rigor, novelty, and significance appropriate for a long-established research journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: General interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Seeks to publish papers of general interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work should be of interest beyond an extremely narrow specialty; results that appeal to a broader segment of the pure mathematics community are preferred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject coverage: pure mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers a broad range of pure mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal's scope is broad within pure mathematics — prospective submissions should fall within traditional or contemporary areas of pure math rather than primarily applied topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication frequency and format
rubrics_metrics.description: The Nagoya Mathematical Journal is published quarterly in print and electronic versions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepted papers will appear in one of the quarterly issues; the electronic version is hosted at CambridgeCore and the journal is published by Cambridge University Press.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authors' rights for older volumes (1–176)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors of articles published in volumes 1–176 may request removal from CambridgeCore if they do not wish their work to be freely available there.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation Nagoya Mathematical Journal will honor requests from authors of volumes 1–176 to remove their work from CambridgeCore; this is a limited-rights/availability policy applying to those earlier volumes.
